Meet

Two ways to meet.
The same local network.

Choose a direct introduction, a shared experience, or keep both open. Aynera gives you a little more context before the next step.

Choose your way

Start with the kind of connection that feels natural to you.

01 · Duos

One good introduction at a time.

A small number of relevant one-to-one introductions, with enough context to understand why meeting each other could be worth exploring.

02 · Squads

A shared way to cross paths.

Small social experiences around shared interests, energy and lifestyle — a more natural way to meet than a formal date.

Explore Squads →

The common ground

Whether you meet in a Duo or a Squad, control stays with you.

Talk first when you need to. Meet in public when you choose to. Nothing becomes more than a conversation unless it is mutual.
